question: What coating thicknesses were reported for NCM@PANI and for NCM@PANI-PEG?
rendered: The coating thicknesses were not reported for NCM@PANI and for NCM@PANI-PEG in the provided text. However, TEM images show the formation of homogeneous and amorphous coatings on NCM-811 particles with a thickness of around 25-30 and 30-35 nm for NCM@PANI (Fig. 8b) and NCM@PANI-PEG (Fig. 8c), respectively.
